records.title: Deep learning for malignant lymph node segmentation and detection: a review
records.reason: This review surveys medical-image lymph-node segmentation and detection; it is a healthcare vision application and does not address LLM inference systems.

records.title: Semantic Image Synthesis with Semantically Coupled VQ-Model
records.reason: The VQ-Model work targets semantic image synthesis quality and conditioning, an independent image-generation application rather than efficient LLM inference.

records.title: On Efficient Language and Vision Assistants for Visually-Situated Natural Language Understanding: What Matters in Reading and Reasoning
records.reason: The paper designs language-and-vision assistants for visually situated text understanding, optimizes vision modules under constrained inference cost, and reports throughput improvements across 160M–13B models.

records.title: Smaller Language Models Are Better Instruction Evolvers
records.reason: The contribution is instruction-data evolution using smaller models for instruction-tuning data quality; the described work is an upstream training-data application, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Learning from Many Voices: Literary MT Using Multi-Reference Human and Synthetic Data
records.reason: The paper improves literary machine translation by selecting human/synthetic references for fine-tuning quality; it presents no LLM serving or inference-efficiency method.

records.title: What Does it Mean for a Neural Network to Learn a "World Model"?
records.reason: This paper defines criteria for identifying neural-network world models and proposes evaluation conditions; it does not present an inference-system optimization.

records.title: When Instructions Multiply: Measuring and Estimating LLM Capabilities of Multiple Instructions Following
records.reason: ManyIFEval and StyleMBPP are benchmarks and regression models for instruction-following capability evaluation; evaluation economy is not an LLM inference-system contribution.

records.title: Off-Trajectory Reasoning: Can LLMs Collaborate on Reasoning Trajectory?
records.reason: The paper studies whether LLMs can collaborate on shared reasoning trajectories and motivates potential inference-efficiency benefits, but its abstract evaluates behavioral recoverability/guidability and reports no actual cost, latency, or throughput improvement.

records.title: Geometric planning for masonry wall construction with natural stones using discrete convolution
records.reason: The paper uses discrete convolution and combinatorial optimization to plan natural-stone masonry walls; its fast geometric computation is specific to construction planning and unrelated to LLM systems.

records.title: Optical Image Processing and Applications Empowered by Vision-Language Models
records.reason: The survey includes inference-efficiency and deployability among constraints for optical image processing with VLMs, but its scope is optical-image applications and it does not isolate general LLM serving methods.

records.title: Coarse-grained reconfigurable architectures for radio baseband processing: A survey
records.reason: This survey studies CGRAs for 5G/6G radio baseband processing. Although it covers energy-efficient accelerators, its target workload is communications baseband rather than LLM/ML inference systems.

records.title: FlashDecoding++Next: High Throughput LLM Inference With Latency and Memory Optimization
records.reason: The author-hosted primary paper matches the candidate title and DOI and describes FlashDecoding++Next as a high-throughput LLM inference engine, directly within the target serving-efficiency scope.

records.title: NASA+: Neural Architecture Search and Acceleration for Multiplication-Reduced Hybrid Networks
records.reason: The candidate's DOI/title are identified, but the registered publisher abstract could not be independently retrieved: Exact DOI route open returned: URL https://doi.org/10.1109/TCSI.2023.3256700 is not accessible via this tool. Exact-title/DOI searches restricted to IEEE Xplore returned no results; secondary ResearchGate metadata showed a candidate abstract but cannot substitute for the publisher abstract. Keep borderline pending primary-source evidence.

records.title: Mamba for Landslide Detection: A Lightweight Model for Mapping Landslides With Very High-Resolution Images
records.reason: The Mamba model is applied to landslide detection from remote-sensing images; the contribution is a domain-specific detection model, not a language-model systems optimization.

records.title: Instruction Backdoor Attacks Against Customized LLMs
records.reason: The paper studies instruction-backdoor attacks against customized LLM applications and trustworthiness risks, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Gaps or Hallucinations? Gazing into Machine-Generated Legal Analysis for Fine-grained Text Evaluations
records.reason: The work develops fine-grained evaluation and detection of hallucination/gaps in legal analysis; it addresses output assessment in a domain application rather than LLM serving.

records.title: Efficient Distributed MLLM Training with Cornstarch
records.reason: Cornstarch improves distributed MLLM training throughput through parallelism strategies; the project contract treats training-only acceleration separately from inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: On the Performance of LLMs for Real Estate Appraisal
records.reason: The study evaluates LLMs for real-estate valuation and prompt-based estimate quality, an application study without inference-system optimization.

records.title: VLAD: A VLM-Augmented Autonomous Driving Framework with Hierarchical Planning and Interpretable Decision Process
records.reason: VLAD applies a fine-tuned VLM to autonomous driving decisions and collision reduction; this is a driving application/quality result rather than a serving-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Long-Tailed Distribution-Aware Router For Mixture-of-Experts in Large Vision-Language Model
records.reason: LTDR changes expert routing in sparse LVLMs and responds to modality-specific token distributions, giving a plausible MoE inference-path connection. The abstract reports benchmark quality and increases expert activation for vision-tail tokens, without evidence of lower inference cost.
